text: US private equity firm Hellman & Friedman is TeamSystem's controlling shareholder, holding a 69% stake as of July 2026, per a corporate filing reported by Reuters; it retained control while selling minority stakes to Francisco Partners and KKR in September 2026.

source.name: Reuters (republished by Global Banking & Finance Review): Francisco Partners, KKR to buy minority stakes in Italy's TeamSystem, sources say
source.quote: H&F, which first invested in TeamSystem in 2016, held a 69% stake in the company as of July, according to a corporate filing.
source.note: Reuters article by Elvira Pollina and Amy-Jo Crowley; reuters.com copy not directly fetchable for scripts, republished here in full. Same article: H&F 'sell a stake of around 10%' to Francisco Partners and ~5% to others including KKR, 'transferring its remaining stake to another fund managed by the private equity firm'.
